title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 26 (Nekite River)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Nekite River
26 That portion of the Province of British Columbia within 100 m of the Department of Fisheries and Oceans (Canada) spawning channel on the Nekite River, located approximately 10 km upstream from the Nekite River estuary at Smith Inlet (approximate position 51° 27' N. Lat., 127° 05' W. Long.). [en. B.C. Reg. 263/86.]
